description: An invoice: number str, customer str, amount Decimal >= 0, status draft | sent | paid

decisions.question: Which fields are required, and which are optional (with which default) - e.g. number: str required, note: str = ""?
Which values are valid for each field (ranges, formats, lengths, allowed states) - e.g. amount >= 0 with 2 decimals, status draft, sent or paid?
decisions.answer: amount >= 0 with at most 2 decimals; status draft, sent or paid; number and customer not empty

decisions.question: Which fields must never appear in a log, an output or an error message (passwords, internal ids, personal data) - e.g. iban - or none?
Is it changed after it is built, or frozen (a new one for every change) - e.g. frozen dataclass?
decisions.answer: Frozen: a change builds a new one (dataclasses.replace)
decisions.suggested: Frozen: a change builds a new one (dataclasses.replace)

safety.question: Wrong input (invalid values, out of range, a wrong format): what must never happen?

hazards.description: An invoice with a negative amount is accepted

prevented_by.statement: every invoice has an amount of zero or more

safety.question: Data exposed (secrets or personal data in a log, an output, an error message): what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: Invoices hold no secret; the customer name is printed only to the person who runs the command
